claim_scope: CPU oracle decomposition: separate page-selection headroom from deployable partial-index score calibration
research_question: If selected pages retain their complete visual index rank/calibration only for oracle accounting, how much full-hybrid gain is recoverable under a VLM construction budget, and how much is lost by realizable page selection versus naive deployable subindex fusion?

primary_fusion.name: rrf60_top100_fixed_global_visual_rank_oracle
primary_fusion.warning: Full visual ranks are forbidden to a deployable method; this fusion isolates selection headroom only.

sensitivity_fusion.name: masked_full_corpus_zscore_oracle
sensitivity_fusion.warning: Full-corpus visual mean/std are forbidden to a deployable method; selected-set zscore and selected-set RRF remain reported as naive deployable diagnostics.

selection_policies.corpus_uniform: even coverage over stable corpus order
selection_policies.text_risk: lowest text posting bytes; if unavailable, lowest historical BM25 Top-100 visibility
selection_policies.history_frequency: history-query BM25 Top-100 discounted access frequency
selection_policies.cover25_frequency75: reserve 25% of budget for text-risk coverage and the remainder for historical discounted frequency
selection_policies.score_oracle: future-query Full visual Top-100 discounted frequency; forbidden and non-deployable
selection_policies.label_rank_oracle: future qrels plus Full text/visual ranks; optimistic non-deployable heuristic, not an exact optimum

gain_recovery: (Q_partial - Q_text) / (Q_full_hybrid - Q_text); omit when absolute denominator < 0.005

online_trace.nonpersistent_baseline: Current-query BM25 Top-20 visual rescoring, discarded after the query; DVI-style retrieval proxy only.
online_trace.persistent_baseline: Current-query BM25 Top-20 visual retrieval representations are retained and exposed to future queries using naive selected-set RRF.

audit_gate.realizable_policy_requirement: At least one history-only policy must beat random/uniform under oracle-fixed scoring, and the deployable calibration gap must be explicitly measured.
audit_gate.persistence_requirement: Repeated construction events must be amortizable; persistent quality is not credited until a deployable calibrated fusion replaces naive selected-set ranking.

information_boundary.warning: Exploratory only; all domains were opened earlier.
information_boundary.v0_result_preserved: The v0 NO-GO from naive selected-set RRF is not overwritten; v1 is a decomposition prompted by that failure.
